This deterministic pruning is mathematically dual to the expansion of the simulation manifold via the 10,000-world correlated Gamma-Poisson engine. While the truth gate restricts the domain, the simulation engine densely populates the codomain with joint probability distributions. The 5-track reasoning hierarchy ($L1..L5$) acts as a series of linear operators $\mathbf{T}_i$ acting upon the base projection vector $\mathbf{p}$. Specifically, $L1$ (Trench) and $L2$ (Coverage) modify the underlying Gamma shape and scale parameters, while $L5$ (Ownership) introduces a penalty term to the MILP objective function to maximize contrarian leverage. The PuLP solver then navigates this highly constrained, multi-objective landscape. The transition from $Tanner McKee$ to $Joe Milton III$ exemplifies a catastrophic failure mode prevented by the truth gate; without it, the simulator would assign non-zero probability mass to an inactive player, poisoning the entire downstream optimization. The cryptographic hash-chain sealing further ensures that the mapping from raw data to optimized lineups is bijective and tamper-evident, creating a verifiable proof-of-work for every generated DFS slate.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architecture inherits from mid-20th century operations research, specifically the simplex method for linear programming, but extends it into the realm of modern stochastic calculus. The use of Gamma-Poisson mixtures echoes classical actuarial science models for claim frequencies, adapted here for discrete play-by-play sports data. The hierarchical reasoning tracks parallel the development of multi-agent reinforcement learning, where global environmental constraints override local agent policies.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system explicitly models the opposing decision actor: the DFS market participant. By incorporating $L5$ Ownership/Portfolio Leverage, the engine anticipates the crowd's tendency to over-select high-profile names. It treats the market as a rational but myopic adversary, optimizing not just for expected points, but for expected rank within the distribution of all submitted lineups. This game-theoretic layer transforms a pure physics problem into a competitive strategic one.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity vetoes are critical when $L1$ Trench metrics and $L2$ Coverage metrics provide conflicting signals. If a defensive front is statistically dominant but the coverage scheme heavily shadows the primary receiver, the system must veto a naive additive combination. Furthermore, if $L4$ Game Environment scripts (e.g., extreme weather) suggest a purely ground-and-pound script, any $L2$ target-share projections for secondary receivers are aggressively down-weighted or vetoed entirely to prevent overestimation of passing volume.
